newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil books 1996 charge for UK gas arm.
newsitem.headline: Statoil books 1996 charge for UK gas arm.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it would take an allocation of 530 million crowns in its 1995 and 1996 accounts to provide for future losses at the British marketing company Alliance Gas.
"Although the market is still demanding, we are making positive progress," Thor Otto Lohne, manager at Alliance Gas, was quoted as saying in Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter.
Alliance has achieved a positive operating result since last autumn.
"Alliance Gas has been reorganised and new structures introduced. We've established common functions with Statoil UK and achieved synergies," Lohne said.
"The company now has 10-12,000 custromers and five percent of the market. This solid position forms a good starting point for further progress at Alliance Gas."
